decisions.summary: Replaced placeholder SQS URL in createUiDefinition_csfdrv2_connector.json with non-URL placeholder text.

Parser alias CrowdStrikeFalconEventStream and the underlying tables behind it (CrowdStrikeAlerts, CrowdStrikeCases, CrowdStrikeDetections, CrowdStrikeHosts, CrowdStrikeVulnerabilities) declared under requiredWorkloads[sentinel]; dependencyReviewRequired=false.
Proceed despite unaccepted Defender workbook contract / packaging stage.

Custom Detections call the solution parser alias (no parser inlining), aligned with Ofer/Ido published Custom Detections. Alert parity for parser-calling Custom Detections is recorded as a platform limitation (Graph refuses to enable Custom Detections that call workspace functions); exact-query row parity is recorded instead.
